statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: BGP implementations MUST recognize all well-known attributes.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Some of these attributes are mandatory and MUST be included in every UPDATE message that contains NLRI.
actions: include mandatory well-known attributes in UPDATE message

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Others are discretionary and MAY or MAY NOT be sent in a particular UPDATE message.

statements.subject: peer
statements.description: Once a BGP peer has updated any well-known attributes, it MUST pass these attributes to its peers in any updates it transmits.
actions: pass updated well-known attributes to peers in all transmitted updates

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: In addition to well-known attributes, each path MAY contain one or more optional attributes.

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: Paths with unrecognized transitive optional attributes SHOULD be accepted.
statements.trigger: receive UPDATE message with unrecognized transitive optional attribute
statements.pre_cond: attribute.optional = true & attribute.transitive = true & attribute.recognized = false
actions: accept path carrying unrecognized transitive optional attribute

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: If a path with an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to other BGP peers, then the unrecognized transitive optional attribute of that path MUST be passed, along with the path, to other BGP peers with the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet set to 1.
statements.trigger: forward path with unrecognized transitive optional attribute to peers
statements.pre_cond: attribute.optional = true & attribute.transitive = true & attribute.recognized = false & path.accepted = true & path.forwarded = true
actions: pass unrecognized transitive optional attribute along with the path to other BGP peers
set Partial bit in Attribute Flags octet to 1

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: If a path with a recognized, transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed along to other BGP peers and the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet is set to 1 by some previous AS, it MUST NOT be set back to 0 by the current AS.
statements.trigger: forward path with recognized transitive optional attribute carrying Partial bit = 1
statements.pre_cond: attribute.optional = true & attribute.transitive = true & attribute.recognized = true & path.accepted = true & path.forwarded = true & attribute.partial_bit = 1
actions: preserve Partial bit at value 1; do not reset Partial bit to 0

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: Unrecognized non-transitive optional attributes MUST be quietly ignored and not passed along to other BGP peers.
statements.trigger: receive UPDATE message with unrecognized non-transitive optional attribute
statements.pre_cond: attribute.optional = true & attribute.transitive = false & attribute.recognized = false
actions: silently ignore unrecognized non-transitive optional attribute
do not forward unrecognized non-transitive optional attribute to other BGP peers

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: New, transitive optional attributes MAY be attached to the path by the originator or by any other BGP speaker in the path.

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: All optional attributes (both transitive and non-transitive), MAY be updated (if appropriate) by BGP speakers in the path.

statements.subject: peer
statements.description: The sender of an UPDATE message SHOULD order path attributes within the UPDATE message in ascending order of attribute type.
actions: order path attributes within UPDATE message in ascending order of attribute type

statements.subject: peer
statements.description: The receiver of an UPDATE message MUST be prepared to handle path attributes within UPDATE messages that are out of order.
statements.trigger: receive UPDATE message with out-of-order path attributes
actions: accept and process path attributes that appear out of order in received UPDATE messages

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The mandatory category refers to an attribute that MUST be present in both IBGP and EBGP exchanges if NLRI are contained in the UPDATE message.
actions: include mandatory attributes in IBGP UPDATE messages containing NLRI
include mandatory attributes in EBGP UPDATE messages containing NLRI
